CISD_HOLDOUT_EVIDENCE_OPPORTUNITIES.reading: the historical holdout offers 84 all-four opening-hour episodes across 7 securities for CISD. This is the number a grammar would actually consume, and it is far smaller than the 2,184 valid bars headline.

ANCHOR_ACQUISITION_LATENCY.measured_from: the first bounded-eligible bar (age==20) of each segment with >=20 COMPLETE bars

REGIME_ANSWER.question: is the bx_up loss because segments are short (A), or because L43 is intrinsically rare (B)?
REGIME_ANSWER.evidence: all 68,392 segments already have >=20 COMPLETE bars, yet 53,581 of them (78.3%) never contain a single L43 bar. L34 and SETUP anchor at median 0 bars on the same segments.
REGIME_ANSWER.consequence: the 43.4% bx_up / 43.5% be_up loss is a property of the L43 event rate, not of Massive coverage. Better coverage would not recover it.
